source.publisher: Ulster Herald (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Returning Officer's Notice of Result (Ulster Herald, 21 May 1955, p. 2, block images read): the name is entered in column 5 for this division, no poll having been taken

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 2 June 1955. There were no contests (Belfast News-Letter, 18 May 1955, p. 8: 'There will be no contests for Castlederg Rural Council'). Fourteen divisions are recorded from the Returning Officer's Notice of Result (Ulster Herald, 21 May 1955, p. 2). Clare and Clunahill are not recorded: the notice crosses the two members' surnames and other names (Clare: 'McCrea, John'; Clunahill: 'Crockett, Michael Henry'), so which member sat for which division in 1955 cannot be read from it; in 1952 and 1958 John Crockett sat for Clare and Michael H. McCrea for Clunahill. Returned unopposed.
